notes: every chart: chart._ssr false, env.node off, 600 x 400, animation false, the grid 60 / 40 / 40 / 40.
a paint (renderToSVGString) after setOption and after every step builds every path and text block.
pointer steps go through zrender's Handler; the timers settle 500 ms before and after every step.
renderItem: '@name' is the recorder of RENDER[name]: the params, every api call and its answer, the tree returned.
ids an author did not write are upstream's with \0 written ~.

cases.note: gantt bars: api.value / coord / size (a category band) / style (the series' and an item's own colour, the series opacity, the ec4 label of an empty text), encode.tooltip and the item tooltip

[r2v] api.style's label rich (createTextStyle's setTokenTextStyle): a token without fontSize / fontWeight / fontStyle / fontFamily takes the plain label's (richInheritPlainLabel), one with its own keeps it
error bars: a group of three lines per item, api.visual(color), a category x axis (api.size along it)
hexagons on two value axes: api.size with a data item, visual borderColor (none written: undefined), barLayout on a value axis (undefined), getWidth / getHeight / getDevicePixelRatio, info

texts: a circle's textContent on top, a free text (ordinalRawValue of a guessed ordinal and of a category, api.font, params.context counting the calls), an ec4 label through api.style with its own text
groups at their points (x / y / rotation of a group), info; a merge of new data: by index the ring leaves, by name the children keep their places and turn
two custom series sharing the band through api.barLayout (count 2, barGap '20%', barCategoryGap 10; count 3 with barWidth and barMaxWidth recorded)
clip: true (widened by lineStyle.width 4) against the default clip: false; squares across the grid edges
a legend over two custom series: the icons; a toggle hides one (currentSeriesIndices drops it) and brings it back (the same elements, updated)
dataZoom inside with filterMode 'weakFilter' on the x axis both ends of a span feed: a span straddling or touching the window stays; dataIndex against dataIndexInside; a dataZoom action's actionType
emphasis: a declared emphasis style on the rect, the default lift on the circle (z2 3, its lift 1), the whole item enters the state together; leave
